info.title: agenteam System outbound policy HTTP
info.description: Only GET and PUT at the two exact paths. All other methods, including HEAD, return 405 with Allow: GET, PUT; HEAD errors have no body. No HEAD fallback, lookup, reload, connectivity probe or pagination. Original Host/Origin/Fetch-Metadata and clean Path/RawPath checks precede routing/auth/body, without redirects, CORS or forwarded-header trust. Exactly one outer RequestID/recovery middleware. Explicit authorized DTOs are the only rule disclosure; ordinary engine formatting remains redacted. Successful response JSON is limited to 1 MiB.

get.description: Current System administrator, rechecked in the same policy read transaction. GET-only, no query (including bare ?), body or write CSRF/key. Local 3-second budget starts before HTTP authentication and inherits earlier parent deadlines, with actual I/O completion before return. Current complete DB observation does not certify mirror availability, send success or a command receipt. Does not Reload.

200.description: Current authorized policy. Empty rules is [], never null.

X-Request-ID.description: One server-owned request identity from the outer middleware; caller input is ignored.

put.description: Current administrator plus same-origin CSRF; same transaction rechecks current Session/authority. Whole-body replacement with original policy service locks, audit and receipt. Local 30-second budget includes preauthentication, bounded body, send gate, transaction, Unknown verification and response preparation; no renewed phase deadlines. An accepted historical key returns its original four-field result without reverting/reloading the process mirror, even while unavailable. Current observations and historical receipt differ. Canonically equal reordered rules/ports preserve command semantics; same key with different semantics conflicts. No automatic retry or cancellation of in-flight sends.

requestBody.description: Single application/json, optional charset=utf-8, no Content-Encoding. UTF-8 serialized bytes including whitespace count toward 1 MiB. Unknown/missing/duplicate fields, nulls, nonobjects and trailing JSON are rejected. No query or caller-supplied identity.

200.description: Original UpdatePolicy receipt; version starts at 2 on first update. No following GET is appended.

get.description: Current System administrator safe projection; independent canonical version. No password, Secret reference or transport capability is returned. Observation is not a command receipt.

put.description: System administrator, current Session, same-origin CSRF and Idempotency-Key. Atomic version CAS, encrypted Secret mapping, Audit and original receipt. Same key/body/version replays the original receipt; different semantics conflict. Credentials use keyed semantic MAC. New requests read current DB-backed routing; enabled proxy never silently falls back to direct. A gateway identity change with a saved credential requires a replacement password or explicit remove, including while mode is direct. Unknown commands retain the exact key/body/version for explicit replay; current GET is never a receipt.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON at most 16 KiB. gateway=null requires mode=direct and credential_action=remove. direct may retain a complete gateway and credentials without using them. Password omission with keep preserves the credential; a nonempty password replaces it; remove forbids password and requires an empty username. Username/password authentication is a pair.

200.description: Original command receipt only; version is the applied command version and is not replaced by a later current value.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: One exact configured deployment origin; forwarding headers do not override it.

Key.name: Idempotency-Key
Key.description: One untrimmed header. Identity is server-owned outbound-policy / current user / update / key. Session and request trace are not command identity.

cidr.description: Canonical netip prefix, masked network bits, non IPv4-mapped; wholly inside RFC1918 or ULA. Fixed forbidden-address classification still wins.

ports.description: Literal all or 1–256 distinct integer JSON tokens. Strings, fraction/exponent notation, zero, negative and overflow are rejected. Input order may vary; stored/returned ports are sorted.

rules.description: Original raw JSON field is limited to 512 KiB before canonicalization; null, duplicate keys at any depth, invalid depth and duplicate canonical rules are rejected. Canonical rule order is not an evaluation priority.

host.description: Canonical ASCII DNS name (single-label gateway allowed) or canonical IP, no URL, credentials, zone, path or port. Block-always addresses are forbidden.

username.description: At most 255 UTF-8 bytes, no controls. HTTP/HTTPS username cannot contain colon.

Problem.description: Safe RFC 9457 Problem. 400 invalid input; 401 unauthenticated/revoked (ordinary authentication errors do not clear Session cookies); 403 current authority/CSRF/Origin denied; 404 unknown path; 405 with Allow: GET, PUT (HEAD has no body); 409 version/key/state conflict; 413 total JSON body exceeds 1 MiB; 415 unsupported media/encoding; 503 unbound/unavailable/CommitUnknown/shutdown; 500 internal error. COMMIT_UNKNOWN preserves commit_state=unknown. Existing rule commands retain retry_hint=lookup compatibility; proxy commands use retry_hint=replay. This domain has no lookup route: explicitly replay the original PUT/key/body with current legal CSRF. A confirmed commit followed by failed current-state recovery preserves commit_state=committed and retry_hint=replay. GET is never a command receipt. No private rules, keys or nested causes in a Problem.
